summary: Vinci Compass Investments Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q1 2026 earnings results via press release. The company reported Fee Related Earnings of R$96.3 million and declared a quarterly dividend of $0.17/share. The press release also mentions an announced combination with BACS in Argentina and ongoing Verde integration, but no formal agreement, price, or premium is provided. This is a routine earnings report with no definitive M&A deal terms, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
